title: About Backup and Restore for Zscaler Client Connector

blocks.text: You can create a backup of Zscaler Client Connector policies and configuration settings and restore them using the backup. A backup represents the date and time when a backup was created and allows you to restore configurations saved at that time. When you restore configuration settings from a backup, it overwrites the existing settings.
Backup and Restore features provide the following benefits and enable you to:

blocks.item: Create backups to secure your policies and configuration settings.
Quickly restore settings to a known approved configuration in the event of policy failure, misconfiguration, or other undesired outcomes.

blocks.heading: About the Backup and Restore Page

blocks.text: On the Backup and Restore page (Administration > Back Up and Restore > Client Connector), you can do the following:

blocks.item: View a list of backups that have been restored.
Modify the display of columns in the table.
View a list of existing backups that were created for your organization. For each backup, you can view:
Backup Date: The date and time the backup was created.
Backup Name: The name of the backup.
Backup Description: A description of the backup, if available.
Created By: The admin that created the backup.
Status: The status of the backup (In Progress, Success, or Failed).
Restore stored policies and configurations from a backup.
